oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: service=inference-hosted-us-west metric=latency_p95 value=1280ms threshold=1000ms severity=page

Alex Chen: saw this, investigating. Primary oncall for this window. I'm going to validate if this is infra noise or real regression.

Maya Patel: ping me @alex if you need handoff — I start primary at 08:00 UTC but can take early if needed.

Samir Kapoor: quick check — any recent deploys to the serving runtime? I don't see recent rollouts in deploy log.

Alex Chen: no deploys. Looking at nodes: some machines report high GPU memory pressure and repeated OOM kills for sidecar metrics.

Alex Chen: running quick triage:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep us-west | wc -l
kubectl logs pod/infer-usw-32 -n inference --since=1h | tail -n 50
```

Alex Chen: logs show a spike in KV cache eviction errors around 02:11 UTC, repeated: "kvcache: failed to restore segment - checksum mismatch". Might be noisy storage backend.

Rachel Li: customer-impact check: metrics show 1.9% increase in 5xx for hosted API and latency p95 for text-generation endpoints up ~30%. Reserved/dedicated customers unaffected.

Samir Kapoor: ok that's bounded impact but pages are noisy. Proposal: temporarily relax latency_p95 alert from 1000ms -> 1500ms for 45m while we mitigate backend storage. This reduces pagination noise for oncall and preserves actual outage detection. Thoughts?

Maya Patel: agree with temporary bump. Make sure we document duration and revert plan. Also notify support channels for any customer escalations.

Alex Chen: I'll open a temporary suppression and add runbook link. Doing it now:
```
/alerts mute --scope service:inference-hosted-us-west --alert latency_p95 --until "+45m" --reason "KV cache backend spike causing noisy pages; mitigation in flight" --owner "Alex Chen"
```

oncall-bot: ACTION: Alert suppression created by Alex Chen for latency_p95; expires in 45 minutes (2100004534).

Rachel Li: adding runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency — follow section "KV cache corruption -> rolling restart of inference nodes".

Samir Kapoor: mitigation steps I'm doing now: 1) isolate affected hosts, 2) restart sidecar process gracefully, 3) flush kvcache checkpoints to S3. I'll post commands as I run them.

Samir Kapoor: running restart on shard-7: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/infer-sidecar-shard-7 -n inference`

Alex Chen: good. Also bump autoscale min for us-west pool by +2 to absorb traffic while nodes stabilize.

Maya Patel: note for handoff — I'm available to be primary at 07:40 UTC if Alex needs to step out. Otherwise I take over at 08:00. Secondary will be Samir for next 2 hours.

Alex Chen: thumbs for handoff plan :thumbsup:. Tracking customer impact: worst-affected routes are long-context chat sessions with heavy KV usage; estimate ~10k requests/min for that cohort. No major revenue customers hit.

Rachel Li: I notified support and left a blurb for CS: "Intermittent latency increases in hosted us-west affecting some long-context sessions; mitigation in flight; no data loss; ETA 45m-1h."

Samir Kapoor: completed flush to S3 and restarted sidecar on shard-7/8. Observability shows p95 trending down from 1280ms -> 980ms over last 4m.

Alex Chen: nice. Keep suppression in place until we confirm three consecutive 5m buckets under 1000ms p95.

Maya Patel: if p95 stays low at my handoff I'll cancel suppression and revert threshold. Reminder to record exact command to revert: 
```
/alerts unmute --id <suppression-id>
/alerts update --scope service:inference-hosted-us-west --alert latency_p95 --threshold 1000ms
```

Alex Chen: marking next steps in thread: 1) monitor for 15m, 2) if stable, revoke suppression and restore threshold, 3) follow up incident note in #postmortems with root-cause analysis.

oncall-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident PD-4829 created (severity=sev2). Oncall: Alex Chen (primary).

Rachel Li: filing a quick incident page: https://redwood.incidents/pd-4829 — add logs and timeline when available.

Samir Kapoor: p95 now 890ms for last 5m window. I'll hold on further restarts unless we see a regression.

Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll be ready to take over if anything pops after 08:00 UTC.

Alex Chen: handing off in 10m — @maya take primary at 07:55 UTC. Leaving notes in the PD and runbook updates.

Maya Patel: acknowledged, taking primary at 07:55 UTC. I will cancel suppression if stable for next 15m.

Alex Chen: thanks everyone. Followup: include suggested follow-up action item to add a health-check for kvcache checksum regressions to catch this earlier.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVE NOTICE: PD-4829 has been acknowledged and is marked as stabilized.

Maya Patel: suppression expired/was revoked at 2100004534; p95 thresholds reverted to 1000ms. Closing thread when postmortem draft is up. :white_check_mark:
